failure_observation.sanitized_error: Avuhz DEVELOPMENT Auth migration identity membership mismatch

basis: Hosted postgres is NOSUPERUSER with CREATEROLE.
PostgreSQL 17 automatically grants a role created by a non-superuser CREATEROLE user back to that creator with ADMIN TRUE, SET FALSE, INHERIT FALSE under the bootstrap superuser.
PostgreSQL 17 states that the non-superuser CREATEROLE creator cannot remove or change that automatic bootstrap-superuser grant.

The current local certification applies the bootstrap artifact as container postgres, while its separate non-superuser regression creates the target role as postgres before testing membership options; it does not reproduce non-superuser CREATEROLE role creation.
